import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
k = rng.integers(0, 6, 20000)
centers = rng.normal(0, 6, (6, 30))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (20000, 30)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(30)])
df['cluster'] = [f'c{v}' for v in k]
df['score'] = df['x0'] * 2 + rng.normal(0, 1, 20000)

steps.name: step +10
steps.report: { epoch: a.umapProgress.epoch, moved: a['anchorXY'][0] !== window.__x, buttons: [...document.querySelectorAll('.controls .buttons button')].map(b => b.textContent.trim()) }

steps.name: hover while paused
steps.eval: const xy = a['anchorXY']; a['onPointer']({ x: 100, y: 100, world: [xy[0], xy[1]] })

steps.name: anchors 5000
steps.report: { anchors: a.prepared.nAnchors, kept: a.prepared.nKept, projection: a.projection, label: [...document.querySelectorAll('.controls .slider .fmt')].map(e => e.textContent.trim()).find(t => t.includes('UMAP on')) }

steps.name: linear sample slider
steps.report: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Sample percentage"]'); return { min: r.min, max: r.max, step: r.step, value: r.value }; })()
